variants.headline: Still in view: ordered goods reach the dock
variants.sub: Imported {good} ordered by {company} has landed at the colony's port.
variants.body:
The company {company} has received its imported order of {good} at the port. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

People live through the interval between an order and its arrival. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
